what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Timor-Leste, as counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
IDMC's last figure for people displaced by conflict and violence is 900, for 2014.
UNHCR's last figure for IDPs of concern is 15860, for 2008.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Timor-Leste in these years, so it does not say why people were displaced.
IDMC's disaster records for Timor-Leste list floods.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 400 in 2009 to 900 in 2014.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2011 to 2014.

how.text: In 2014, IDMC recorded 2086 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Timor-Leste.
